name: Ahmedabad–Dholera Expressway

route.start: Sarkhej (Sardar Patel Ring Road), Ahmedabad, Gujarat

timeline.event: Construction begins on the greenfield route
Opened to traffic in January; formally inaugurated in March

history: This expressway was built to connect Ahmedabad with Dholera, the site of India's first big planned 'greenfield' smart city, the Dholera Special Investment Region. It starts at the Sardar Patel Ring Road near Sarkhej and runs south on an entirely new alignment, ending near Adhelai village beyond Dholera. Built by NHAI under the Bharatmala programme and opened in early 2026, it shrinks the Ahmedabad–Dholera trip from over two hours to about one, and also serves the upcoming Dholera International Airport.
facts: Built as the main road link to the Dholera Special Investment Region and the new Dholera International Airport.
Cuts the Ahmedabad–Dholera journey to roughly an hour.
A brand-new 'greenfield' road — it doesn't follow any older highway.

sources.title: NHAI — National Highways Authority of India
